name: Singularix
author: omarchy.fans
description: Singularix.ai technology, now available locally as a shell plugin on Omarchy. An Agent Dashboard with Rix, a chief-of-staff agent on your local GPU that manages every agent you spin up (Hermes Agent, OpenClaw; local, Docker, or Omarchy.Fans Cloud) and hands work to bigger models: API keys, browser sign-in, or OpenAI-compatible GPU endpoints. Shows input and output tokens and USD, in total and per task.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens the persistent Singularix dashboard (right click: quick agent switcher) with a badge when an agent needs you.
